abstract: We study the obstruction to a holomorphic partial connection on a vector bundle over a smooth ample divisor in a complex abelian variety. Let the ambient variety have dimension $n\ge4$, and suppose a global three-term complex restricts to the bundle. Two explicit cohomology vanishings allow a diagonal class in $H^{n-2}(\mathcal O_X)$ to be completed to an actual ambient Ext class. Pairing it with the partial Atiyah class gives a formula involving the divisor, the bivector, and the first Chern class of one direct summand of the complex. If that summand has ample or inverse-ample determinant, the map from constant bivectors to partial Atiyah classes is injective. The other terms need not split. This excludes all global positive split symplectic monads satisfying the local-freeness hypothesis, independently of endpoint rank and section choices. After the half-normal twist, it also excludes first-order module deformations in every nonzero pure Poisson direction with arbitrary gerbe component and zero ordinary deformation component. An explicit determinant-trivial rank-two monad on an abelian fourfold has a Poisson-plus-gerbe direction annihilating its full Chern character, yet its partial Atiyah obstruction is nonzero. The Bott normal bundle provides a positive control: its intrinsic normal derivatives do not extend to ambient sections. Exact exterior-algebra checks accompany the proof. The result restricts proposed sheaf carriers in generalized Weil-class constructions; it proves neither a new case nor a counterexample to the rational Hodge conjecture.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
title: A Serre-duality obstruction to partial connections on monads over abelian varieties
